text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I've finished bringing in — the hand towels we hung out to dry.
choice_data_list: <size=38>Thank you, those go in the kitchen cabinet…</size>

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day before the summer training camp. We had headed to the facility ahead of the other Horsegirls to help with the preparations.

text_block_list.name: Facility Staff
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you're a lifesaver! 
We're so grateful you came to help us again this year.
choice_data_list: <size=38>Not at all, it's just something I do on my own</size>

text_block_list.name: Facility Staff
text_block_list.text: That's exactly what we're grateful for! And to think your trainee would go out of her way to help us, too… We really appreciate all your hard work today.
choice_data_list: When I told her about it, she volunteered to accompany me

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Ah — yes. It's not something I usually get to do — so I was hoping I could be of some help to everyone else participating, even if only a little.

text_block_list.name: Facility Staff
text_block_list.text:
Oh…! I'd expect nothing less from your trainee, Trainer. 
We're looking forward to working with you both today!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
…Okay, that's the last cover done… 
Trainer, this pillow is — the very last one.
choice_data_list: Good work, you've been a huge help

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I gazed at the pillows piled high in the closet, realizing once again just how many Horsegirls were participating in the training camp.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Many of my classmates will be joining the training camp, too. Starting tomorrow — it's going to be quite lively around here, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But… right now, we were all alone. Only her voice echoed softly… and outside the window, the trees swayed gently.
choice_data_list: It's nice like this, all empty and quiet
It's nice like this, all empty and quiet

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —Yes. The feel of the tatami, and the soft sunlight — it's all very calming.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: In the past — did you always volunteer all by yourself, Trainer? With this much work — it must have taken quite a long time.
choice_data_list: I used to spend all day working on it with the facility staff

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Oh, my…

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Helping out like this — you're doing it voluntarily, aren't you? Um… what makes you go to such lengths?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's true that this help falls outside my official duties. 
But still… I want to do whatever I can, even if only a little.
choice_data_list: Because I want everyone to have the best summer camp possible

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The training regimen will be grueling during the camp. 
That's exactly why I want the Horsegirls to be as comfortable as possible.
choice_data_list: <size=40>Of course, that goes for you too, Bouquet!</size>
<size=40>Of course, that goes for you too, Bouquet!</size>

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
………Yes. 
Thank you so much — Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ………Hehe.
choice_data_list: —Bouquet?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, I just… remembered something. Our trip to the botanical garden together — and the time we spent waiting.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: That gentle, comforting… time we shared.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
…Well then — now that the pillows are ready, 
what should we help out with next—

text_block_list.name: Facility Staff
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Bouquet, thank you both for your hard work. 
Thanks to the two of you, all the preparations are complete!
choice_data_list: ! —We finished early this year

text_block_list.name: Facility Staff
text_block_list.text: Yes, we're truly grateful to Bouquet for helping out, too. Thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: Facility Staff
text_block_list.text:
Please let us treat you to dinner as a thank you. 
I'll call you when it's ready.
choice_data_list: <size=38>If you'd like, shall we help out with that, too?</size>

text_block_list.name: Facility Staff
text_block_list.text:
No, no, you two are going to be busy starting tomorrow. 
Please just relax and take it easy for the rest of today. 
See you in a bit!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Ah………
choice_data_list: <size=36>…Looks like we're back to waiting again, huh?</size>
<size=36>…Looks like we're back to waiting again, huh?</size>

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
…Hehe. 
Yes, we are.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: In that case… would you like to go for a short walk outside? The sun is starting to set, so it should be getting cooler…
choice_data_list: Sounds good, let's do that
Sounds good, let's do that

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, as we waited for dinner to be ready, 
I decided to take a stroll along the nearby beach with her.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
It's such a beautiful sunset, isn't it? 
It's reflecting off the waves — shimmering so beautifully.
choice_data_list: Yeah. It's somehow so peaceful
Yeah. It's somehow so peaceful

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two of us were enveloped by the gentle sea breeze. Illuminated by the setting sun, the golden ocean ebbed and flowed in a peaceful, steady rhythm.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
…Somehow, lately — I feel like wherever we go, 
we always end up waiting together, Trainer.
choice_data_list: <size=38>Thanks for spending time with me today, too</size>

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes — I love the times we spend waiting like this. 
It's so peaceful — and warm.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I find them really pleasant, too
Yeah, I find them really pleasant, too

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: It might be — the exact same feeling I get when nurturing flowers. I don't know when they will bloom, but—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
While waiting, tending to them, caring for them… 
Imagining the moment they finally bloom is so enjoyable. And—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: …I feel like it's a joy I can share with you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: If… if the two of us were to keep waiting for the same flower — then when it finally blooms, I'll be able to share that joy with you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I'm sure — not just for the flowers, but even for our future, far ahead.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Just thinking about it — fills me with such a warm feeling inside.
choice_data_list: Bouquet…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At that moment, a sudden, strong gust of sea breeze blew past… Just a little ways ahead, I saw the sand swirling. And then—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Out in the sand, something caught the setting sun, shining with a sudden glint.
choice_data_list: Hm… is that—?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When we got closer, we saw a small, pink object peeking out from the sand, glinting in the setting sun.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
This is — a seashell, isn't it? 
It looks just like a cherry blossom petal — it's so lovely.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: If the breeze hadn't blown — would it have stayed buried in the sand forever, I wonder?
choice_data_list: <size=40>Yeah… we might never have found it either</size>
<size=40>Yeah… we might never have found it either</size>

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: In that case… it must have just bloomed, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A single petal in the sand. The crimson sky and the golden sea. And — Curren Bouquetd'or's gentle smile.
choice_data_list: It's so… beautiful
It's so… beautiful

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Hehe, somehow… I want to see even more of it. 
That blooming future… waiting far ahead.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I don't know what shape it will take. 
And it may take a very long time to reach, but—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Any flower I look at with you… I just know it will be truly beautiful.
choice_data_list: …Yeah, I'm sure of it
…Yeah, I'm sure of it

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And if such a future exists — then showing her the moment that flower blooms is my duty, and mine alone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I picked up the shining seashell from the sand — and held it straight out to her.
choice_data_list: I promise you, Bouquet

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Trainer…?
choice_data_list: <size=36>With you — I promise to make our future bloom</size>
<size=36>With you — I promise to make our future bloom</size>

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: …………Yes. Let's wait for that moment together.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Until the day it blooms — just the two of us.
